title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-5b71e42df8cbf4389009bde9
behavioral_concerns: follow up: QA operation mapping allows caller supplied model/task variations via alternative kinds or omits strict shard ID format validation beyond presence check

evidence.summary: QA guard in operation_handlers.go checks only presence/mutual exclusion for Shard, no regex format check; Shard assigned directly to req.Task
Contract test verifies QA rejects model/task/status-shard/recovery-shard but does not test malformed shard format acceptance
Kind normalization uses ReplaceAll underscore->dash and explicit qa- prefixed cases; QA prefix guard blocks model/task/stage etc. for all QA kinds
Dispatch identifierPattern is generic ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ and qa_handlers shard handlers pass raw shard to app layer without web-layer strict validation

theories.claim: QA start/resume operation mapping omits strict shard ID format validation beyond presence check; arbitrary strings accepted as options.shard
theories.basis: Behavioral concern states follow-up about omitting strict shard ID format validation. In internal/web/operation_handlers.go the QA branch only checks presence/mutual-exclusion/kind eligibility for options.Shard, with no regex/length/format check.
theories.verification_surface: Read-only inspection of internal/web/operation_handlers.go:734-751 (QA options guard) and internal/web/operations_contract_test.go:68-87 (contract test allows only map-owned shard value qa-v1-shard-… but does not test malformed shard acceptance), plus internal/web/handlers.go:22-23 and dispatch validIdentifier check which is generic.
theories.confirmation_condition: mapOperationRequest accepts qa-start/qa-resume with options.shard set to arbitrary value (e.g., 'arbitrary', '../../etc', 'not-a-valid-format') that does not match canonical shard pattern qa-v1-shard-[0-9a-f]{24,} while rejecting only by kind/suite rules
theories.refutation_condition: Code performs explicit regex or length/charset validation of shard IDs against canonical pattern (e.g., ^qa-v1-shard-[a-f0-9]{...}$ or opaqueRefPattern with strict prefix) before assigning to req.Task
theories.inconclusive_condition: Shard validation is delegated outside assigned paths (app layer) and cannot be verified with web-layer reads alone, or alternative kinds handling is ambiguous
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read operation_handlers.go QA guard block and grep for shard validation patterns, identifierPattern/opaqueRefPattern usage, and QA shard test coverage without executing code or mutating state

theories.outcome_reason: internal/web/operation_handlers.go:734-751 checks only that Shard is present only for qa-start/qa-resume, that Suite is smoke and mutually exclusive, and that other QA options are empty. No validation of shard format (regex, prefix qa-v1-shard-, length, charset) exists; assignment is req.Task = options.Shard directly via kind switch at 700-705 and forwarded without sanitize. Test at operations_contract_test.go:68-87 verifies model/task rejection and suite/shard mutual exclusion but does not assert malformed shard rejection, leaving arbitrary shard strings accepted at the web boundary.

theories.claim: QA operation mapping allows caller-supplied model/task variations via alternative kinds to bypass the QA-only options filter
theories.basis: Concern hypothesizes alternative kind strings (aliases, underscore vs dash) could route to QA OperationKind without triggering the strings.HasPrefix(req.Kind,"qa-") guard that blocks model/task/stage etc.
theories.verification_surface: Read-only inspection of internal/web/operation_handlers.go:623-753 (kind normalization and QA guard) and internal/web/operations_contract_test.go:68-87 and static/js/operations.js:5-17
theories.confirmation_condition: An alternative kind alias exists that maps to app.OperationQAStart/Resume/Status etc. without qa- prefix or the QA guard fails to block options.Model/Task/Stage etc. for that alias
theories.refutation_condition: All operation kinds mapping to QA OperationKind are normalized via strings.ReplaceAll("_","-") and trimmed, then matched only to explicit case labels 'qa-start','qa-resume','qa-status','qa-dry-run','qa-recover', and the guard if strings.HasPrefix(string(req.Kind),"qa-") blocks Model, Task, Stage, ToStage, Action, DryRun, Resume, Level, Test, Timeout, ForceReview, RestartReview, OverrideRationale, ReviewFocus, Sources, Dimensions, Parallelism for any matched QA kind
theories.inconclusive_condition: Additional aliases are defined outside assigned paths or guard is intentionally permissive for future kinds
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read kind switch and prefix guard, enumerate all QA case labels, verify normalization, and compare against contract test coverage for caller model/task rejection without executing mutations

theories.outcome_reason: All QA OperationKind assignments in operation_handlers.go:696-707 come from explicit normalized cases 'qa-status','qa-dry-run','qa-start','qa-resume','qa-recover' which all carry qa- prefix after ReplaceAll underscore->dash normalization at 623. The subsequent guard at 734-735 checks if strings.HasPrefix(req.Kind,"qa-") then rejects any non-empty Model, Task, Stage, ToStage, Action, DryRun, Resume, Level, Test, Timeout, ForceReview, RestartReview, OverrideRationale, ReviewFocus, Sources, Dimensions, Parallelism with error 'QA operations accept only options.shard or options.suite'. Contract test TestBrowserQAOperationContractAllowsOnlyMapOwnedShard at operations_contract_test.go:75-86 confirms model, task, status-shard, recovery-shard are rejected. No alternative kind alias escapes the guard; static/js/operations.js:5-17 also only forwards shard/suite for QA, and model is separately collected but server-side mapping would reject it.
